thread:
kevin: Quick postmortem follow-up from yesterday's multi-region retry spike during cert roll. root cause looks like LB re-advert timing overlap + downstream conn drain race.
marta: thanks. can someone own remediation items?
oliver: I can take LB advert sequencing and add a short grace period after cert swap. ETA: 2024-12-04.
kevin: can you also add a canary plan? we want minimal user impact.
oliver: plan: 0.5% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 36h with autoscale hold, rollback if retries >0.25% absolute.
path-bot: [alert] incident-2024-11-26: routing-flap detected between eu-west -> us-east, roll id 5621.
susan: I'll own sequencer drain semantics and the healthcheck gating. ETA: 2024-11-30. will add a metric for pre/post-route-gap_ms.
kevin: concrete actions: 1) Add post-rotate advertise delay (owner: oliver, eta: 2024-12-04). 2) Gate advertise on drain+health (owner: susan, eta: 2024-11-30). 3) Canary + dashboards (owner: oliver, eta: 2024-12-05).
marta: please open issue tickets and link dashboards. ops needs them wired.
oliver: created ticket INFRA-4977 for advertise delay + canary steps. link: https://rwd-issues/INFRA-4977.
susan: created ticket SEQ-1122 for drain gating and metric. link: https://rwd-issues/SEQ-1122.
kevin: add these to the recurring-incident tracker; pattern repeated twice in last 60 days. schedule a 3-month audit.
marta: noted, adding to tracker and scheduling audit.
kevin: small mitigation in the meantime: force regional-sticky routing for 48h post-rotation for affected prefixes (owner: marta, eta: 2024-11-27).
path-bot: [workflow] INFRA-4977 assigned to oliver (due 2024-12-04). SEQ-1122 assigned to susan (due 2024-11-30).
oliver: config snippet I'll attach to INFRA-4977: ```
# edge.cfg
rotation:
  advertise_delay_ms: 12000
  enable_gated_advertise: true
```
susan: adding histogram metric `route_gap_ms` and alert p95>80ms. will also add a synthetic probe for canary validation.
marta: please schedule 15m weekly check-ins until both tickets are closed.
kevin: invites sent for 4 weeks. please update ticket comments when PRs are open so ops can validate telemetry.
marta: closing thread for now. ping here if any ETA slides or new findings.
